name: upgrade-dependencies
description: Upgrade workspace dependencies to the newest resolvable versions, fix breakages, and verify with the full gate plus Android builds.

scope.description: Which packages to upgrade: `all`, or a comma-separated list such as `firebase_messaging,flutter_local_notifications`.

steps.prompt:
Upgrade dependencies ({{scope}}) in the Mattel Task Receiver monorepo at the workspace root. Follow .kiro/skills/upgrade-dependencies/SKILL.md exactly.

1. `fvm flutter pub outdated` at the root and record current vs latest.
2. Upgrade with `fvm flutter pub add <pkg>` (or `fvm flutter pub upgrade --major-versions` for `all`) inside the member packages that declare them. Restore every touched member's analysis_options.yaml to exactly `include: ../../analysis_options.yaml`.
3. Read CHANGELOGs of every package whose major/minor changed; apply required code, Gradle (apps/*/android) or manifest changes. Verify any Gradle plugin version exists on Google Maven / Maven Central before using it.
4. `make codegen l10n`, then `make analyze test`. Fix failures in the code, not by loosening tests or lints.
5. `make build-debug APP=watch ENV=dev` and `make build-debug APP=mobile ENV=dev`.
6. Add a docs/DECISIONS.md entry for any deliberate deviation (for example a deprecated API kept for contract reasons).

Commit nothing. Report: upgraded packages with old -> new versions, code changes made, anything held back and why, and the gate results.

Review the uncommitted dependency upgrade in the Mattel Task Receiver workspace (`git diff`). Re-run `make verify` and both `make build-debug` targets yourself. Block if any gate fails, if a changelog breaking change was not handled, if lints/tests were weakened, or if the watch app gained camera/ML Kit dependencies. Write the verdict.
